verdict.rationale:
Claude Code's automations (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks) are stored as plain files that can be version-controlled via Claude Code's native git integration (stage, commit, branch, PR) and diffs can be reviewed via the IDE/VS Code inline diff viewer, giving an implicit path to version/review/rollback. However there's no dedicated feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations themselves (e.g., skill/hook change history, routine versioning, or an audit trail distinct from generic git usage).

missing for 10: dedicated automation-specific version history/audit log, built-in rollback UI for skills/hooks/routines, review workflow tailored to automation changes rather than general code diffs.
